info.title: BookLeaf Support API
info.description:
REST API behind the BookLeaf Author Support & Communication Portal.

**Authentication.** Browsers sign in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login` and receive httpOnly session cookies.
API clients (Postman, scripts) call `POST /api/v1/auth/token` and send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

**Roles.** `/api/v1/me/*` is for authors and is always scoped to the caller's own account; `/api/v1/admin/*` is for the BookLeaf team.
Authors receive 404 for anything that is not theirs.

**Errors.** Every error is an RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` document with a stable `code`,
a human `detail`, per-field `errors` for validation failures and the `requestId` to quote to support.

**Concurrency.** Admin ticket reads return an `ETag`; send it back as `If-Match` on `PATCH` to avoid overwriting a colleague's change (412 on conflict).
`POST` endpoints that create records accept an `Idempotency-Key` (UUID) header so retries never duplicate.

**Realtime.** `GET /api/v1/events` is a Server-Sent Events stream of thin change notifications for the caller's role.

post.description: Creates the ticket immediately; Leaf triages it in the background (the response never waits on AI). Send an `Idempotency-Key` so a retried request cannot create a duplicate.

post.description: Answers general questions immediately. When BookLeaf's team needs to act, `needsHuman` is true and `suggestedTicket` contains a pre-filled query to submit.

post.summary: Tell Leaf whether an answer helped
Create a signed upload URL for an attachment
post.description: PUT the file to `uploadUrl` with the returned headers, then pass `attachmentId` when creating the ticket or reply. JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB.

get.description: Filter by `status`, `category`, `priority` (comma-separated), `assignee` (me | unassigned | id), `createdFrom`/`createdTo` (dates), `flag`, `sla` (breached | at_risk) or full-text `q` (also matches BL-numbers). Default sort `urgency` puts unresolved, most urgent and oldest tickets first.

get.summary: Ticket workspace: thread, notes, timeline, Leaf triage and draft, author context

patch.summary: Change status, or override Leaf’s category / priority
patch.description: Send the ETag from GET as `If-Match` to avoid overwriting a colleague’s change (412 if the ticket changed). Status changes follow the ticket state machine (409 with the allowed transitions otherwise).

put.summary: Assign the ticket (to "me", a colleague, or null to unassign)

post.summary: Send a reply to the author (optionally from a Leaf draft, optionally resolving)

get.summary: Internal notes (never visible to the author)
Leaf's latest draft reply for a ticket

post.summary: Regenerate or refine the draft (streams with Accept: text/event-stream)
post.description: Send a `preset` (shorter, warmer, …) or a free-text `instruction` to refine the latest draft, or neither for a fresh one. With `Accept: text/event-stream` the reply streams as `start` → `delta`* → `done` events (`reset` if a model fails mid-answer and another takes over; `error` on failure).

post.summary: Re-run Leaf triage (e.g. after the AI was unavailable)
